speaker: Utpaladeva (closing)
question: Proved — yet for whom in vain?
premises: Though proved by a thousand blazing reasons (samujjvalan nyāyasahasrasādhito'py upaiti).
It succeeds not for the deluded-minded (siddhiṃ na vimūḍhacetasām).
Maheśvara, placed on the palm, yet flees the fate-struck — the true jewel (maheśvaraḥ pāṇitalasthito'pi san palāyate daivahatasya sanmaṇiḥ).
inference: Proof needs fitness; the jewel flees the fated.

speaker: Utpaladeva (signature)
question: Who shines within — and who signs?
premises: One's own self indeed — this — flashes forth: Īśvara within all breathers (svātmaivāyaṃ sphurati sakalaprāṇinām īśvaro'ntaḥ).
Maker and knower too (kartā jñātāpi ca).
Yet recognition of the beyond is to be effected (yadi paraṃ pratyabhijñāsya sādhyā).
And the joining is made by us elsewhere (sā cāsmābhir vihitaghaṭanānyatra).
But Īśvara-proved stands even in duality (kiṃ tv īśasiddhir dvaite'py asti).
Fitting, and more: fire shines at midnight (ity ucitam adhikaṃ bhāti vahnir niśīthe).
inference: Self is Īśvara within all; the proof stands even dualist; signature and forward glance.
uncertainties: pratyabhijñā-program link: recognition to be effected — the work's forward glance to the Īśvarapratyabhijñā; joining 'made by us elsewhere' points outside this treatise.
